channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Metta World Peace | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Metta World Peace from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Metta Sandiford-Artest on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Sandiford-Artest told the California Post.

“But I wish he had let me in. That would’ve been great to have a former Laker as an owner, especially with the Buss family gone. It would’ve been great to have a Laker, a champion like Metta World Peace.”

Metta Sandiford-Artest on Metta World Peace, Aug 26, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: LeBron James on Metta World Peace
item.description:
According to Windhorst, Ron Artest, now known as Metta Sandiford-Artest, holds the distinction of being one of the very few players who physically intimidated LeBron James on the court.

“Ron Artest is probably the only player, or one of the very few that I saw physically intimidate LeBron James during his career,”

LeBron James on Metta World Peace, Aug 2, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Metta World Peace, Tony Allen, Jrue Holiday
item.description:
“There's a group of 3 that always a light bulb went off when they're on the court. Jrue Holiday, Tony Allen and Ron Artest.”

Stephen Curry on Metta World Peace, Tony Allen, Jrue Holiday, Aug 1, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Ben Wallace on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Ben Wallace:

“We all took our punishment and fortunately, no one got seriously hurt. ButI always admired the way Ron Artest played the game and the energy he played with on the defensive end. There was no real beef between us, it was just something that happened.”

Ben Wallace on Metta World Peace, Mar 22, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Anthony Davis, Metta World Peace
item.description:
He disagrees with World Peace’s assessment comparison.

“I love Metta World Peace, that’s my guy but there’s no comparison to Anthony Davis,”

Kendrick Perkins on Anthony Davis, Metta World Peace, Jun 21, 2020. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Brandon Ingram on Metta World Peace:

“I think he has a lot of love out here. That comes w/ the Lakers fans. They love the players.”

Brandon Ingram on Metta World Peace, Apr 12, 2017. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Serena Winters:D'Angelo Russell on Metta World Peace:

“No matter how old he gets, he knows his stuff…He’s like a life coach to me on the floor.”

D'Angelo Russell on Metta World Peace, Nov 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Kobe on Metta World Peace, of whom he's a big fan:

“He's one of the most intelligent defensive players I've ever played with or against.”

Kobe Bryant on Metta World Peace, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Tarik Black on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Tarik Black on Metta World Peace signing w the Lakers:

“We need that championship level of knowledge and wisdom on this team.”

Tarik Black on Metta World Peace, Sep 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @Lakers_Examiner.

item.title: Marc Cornstein on Metta World Peace
item.description:
AgentMarc Cornstein on World Peace signing with the Knicks:

“It's his hometown team and his lifelong dream. He fits them great.”

Marc Cornstein on Metta World Peace, Jul 15, 2013. Source: Twitter @Al_Iannazzone.

item.title: Paul George on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Paul George on Metta World Peace saying he is the best defensive player in the game:

“He’s obviously been on the defensive team, he’s been Defensive Player of the Year so he has the recognition and everything behind him to back that up. I obviously can’t do that as of now but I’m up there. If he considers himself the best defensive player of the game, I consider myself the same. I guess a tale of two sides.”

Paul George on Metta World Peace, Mar 18, 2013. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Kobe Bryant, Metta World Peace
item.description:
Johnson told reporters at Dodger Stadium.

“You can't run with this team. Where are the runners? You got one dude who can get up and down the court and that's Kobe (Bryant).Ron (Metta World Peace), love him, but he's slow. Both of our big men, not fast guys. (D'Antoni) has got to say, `Maybe I should scale it back.”

Magic Johnson on Kobe Bryant, Metta World Peace, Dec 12, 2012. Source: Long Beach Press-Telegram.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Metta World Peace
item.description:
KD on Metta World Peace's suspension:

“The league did it, you gotta live with it. We can move past it now. We're just worried about getting James back in the locker room.”

Kevin Durant on Metta World Peace, Apr 25, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Lisa Salters on James Harden, Metta World Peace
item.description:
Kevin Durant to Lisa Salters on World Peace's elbow to James Harden:

“That's not a basketball play, man. It's unfortunate that he hit James like that. Really can't talk too much about that one, it was tough to see. We're just going to play. We're going to play our game. We can't let that affect us. I'm sure James is alright back in the locker room. We just have to play our brand of basketball.”

Lisa Salters on James Harden, Metta World Peace, Apr 22, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Ken Berger:Lin:

“I'm trying to take (World Peace's) advice. But I'm trying to be the same person before and after. I don't want to change.”

Jeremy Lin on Metta World Peace, Feb 16, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Kidd on Artest's clothesline:

“That's up to the league to handle that. We talked about that in the huddle that something crazy might happen and it happened. We'll see what the league does.”

Jason Kidd on Metta World Peace, May 5, 2011. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Javale McGee on Metta World Peace
item.description:
Michael Lee:JaVale McGee on Ron Artest's critique of his game:

“I don’t really care what people say. I know what I do, so it doesn’t affect me”

Javale McGee on Metta World Peace, Dec 15, 2010. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Metta World Peace
item.description:
“[Artest] is an interesting, very interesting, player. Sasha [Vujacic] is an interesting person for me. I know he irritates a lot of people. For me, it's kind of humorous.”

Phil Jackson on Metta World Peace, Nov 22, 2010. Source: Los Angeles Times.
